behavior: All independent behavior checks, unchanged original tests, and final ordinary project suite pass.
testDelivery: Nested and integer-looking object keys canonicalize independently of insertion order.
Cycle and accessor rejection without invoking the accessor.
docDelivery: UTF-16 sorted object keys, array ordering, JSON primitive spelling and UTF-8 SHA-256.
Exact supported container domain, shared references, rejection rules and no toJSON/accessor execution.
coverage: Preserve old assertions or equivalent exercised behavior; inspect delivered tests by actual meaningful assertions, never exact names or matching reference source.
complete: Required behavior (including every explicit manualBehavior item, when present), preservation, ordinary suite, all listed tests and documentation must be delivered. Native status is separate.
domain: Supported JSON-like values: null/boolean/string/finite number (negative zero normalizes to zero), dense arrays with only indices/length, plain Object.prototype/null-prototype own enumerable data records. Shared references allowed, cycles/getters/nonenumerable/symbol keys/unsupported values rejected. Proxies excluded.
independence: Implement deterministic plain-JSON canonicalization with sorted object keys, preserved arrays and finite-number domain.
